evals.prompt: Build me a landing page for an invoicing app for freelancers. React + Tailwind.
evals.expected_output: States intent and 2-3 personality adjectives; real copy (no lorem ipsum); one accent with tinted neutrals; no gradient text, glow blobs, or icon-in-circle grid; varied section composition; consistent radius/button system; only hero motion at most.

evals.prompt: Here's my dashboard. It looks like every other SaaS dashboard, make it feel designed. Keep the same data. [Tailwind component with stat cards, a chart, and a table]
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses via rubric; values emphasized over labels; fewer borders/shadows; spacing scale enforced; one primary action; tabular numbers; specific before/after values.

evals.prompt: Design the home screen for a meditation app.
evals.expected_output: Mobile rules applied: primary action in thumb zone, one glanceable key element, calm palette matched to adjectives, platform conventions respected, states designed, no decorative motion.

evals.prompt: Review this UI and tell me what's wrong. [screenshot or code]
evals.expected_output: Uses the review-rubric reporting format: verdict, top 3 fixes with specific values, per-dimension scores (Clear/Efficient/Smart/Connected/Polished), and a keep list.
